issues.description: The proposal states as a definitive fact that the approach will focus exclusively on incrementally fixing the current custom dispatch tool workflows. However, the Client Matrix indicates a direct contradiction between stakeholders on whether to fix current workflows or replace the entire platform. Stating a contradicted item as a fact is a critical error.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the definitive statements about exclusively fixing the current workflows. Frame the approach to evaluate the best path during discovery, and move the fix vs. replace debate to the Open Questions section.

issues.description: The contradiction regarding whether to fix the current workflows or replace the platform entirely is missing from the Open Questions section.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a bullet point in the Open Questions section addressing the internal disagreement between fixing the current workflows incrementally versus replacing the platform entirely.

issues.description: The low-confidence success criteria regarding 60-70 percent of Phase 1 workflow logic surviving a future platform change is missing from the Open Questions section. Low-confidence items must be clarified here.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a question to the Open Questions section to validate the expectation that a majority of Phase 1 workflow logic needs to survive a future platform change.

issues.description: There is a typo in the text: 'working working capital'.

risks: The proposal takes a definitive stance on a highly contested internal debate regarding whether to fix or replace the platform, which could alienate the stakeholder advocating for a full replacement.
Multiple unresolved contradictions regarding budget, timeline, and platform strategy pose a significant risk to project scoping and successful delivery if not aligned immediately during discovery.
